title: Extend the template: pause button + best-score HUD persisted with ConfigFile
prompt: Extend this existing game without breaking it: add a Pause button (top-right, large touch target) that toggles get_tree().paused and shows a semi-transparent 'Paused — tap to resume' overlay; add a 'Best' label to the HUD that stores and reloads the best score with ConfigFile at user://save.cfg; keep tests/smoke_test.gd passing and add a check that the best score is loaded as a float. Everything must pass godot_verify.
